BiblicalUsage: Maarath was a city in the hill country of Judah, named in the list of the cities given to the tribe, alongside Beth-anoth and Eltekon. It stands in the record as one of the six cities with their villages in that district.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maarath matters because God gave His people towns by name, and every city in the inheritance was counted and kept.
